notes.title: Many bug fixes and a new map!
notes.notes:
Update Log 0.6


General Updates:


 Update – made the 7 and 1 have a more distinct look within the font atlas.
 Update – New Skin (watermelon)
 Update – New Skin (fish)
 Update – Three new ree’s courtesy of Rad. They have been added as death sounds since they are semi-sad rees.


Goblin Tag


 NEW MAP – Goblin Tag – The Keep
 Bug fix – Taggers respawn with their upgrades now.


Dodgeball


 Bug fix -95% sure that you cant kill your teammates or yourself with the ball when you both go to pick it up.
 Bug fix -Fixed a bug that would stop the ball from killing players after it was picked up from touching a wall.
 Bug fix – Red goblins had their move speed bonus like normal. In this mode everyone should be equal at start. All goblins now start with 10 movement speed instead of 14.
 Bug fix – dodge balls always spawned starting with the red team; now it is random.


Arena


 Bugfix - Rebuilt the skybox – it had run away for some reason
 Pillars
 Update - Made the invisible wall MUCH bigger. No more jumping over.
 Update - Added a new spawn position for balls.


Speedruns

 Update – added a mesh collider to the base of the spinning paddles.
 Bug fix – fixed issues with maps getting stuck on load. 
 Bug fix – powerups were not visible on the bottom after death.


Graveyard


 Update – Changed difficulty to hard


Tower -> Midnight Run


 Update - Fixed a hole that goblins could get stuck on right at the beginning. 
 Update – Name changed to Midnight Run


Hide and seek

Hidden Hallow

[olist]
 Update - Much more aggressive death walls, be careful on the cliffs. 
[/olist]

Park


 Update / bugfix – Moved the spawn locations for both hider and seekers.
 Update – Changed the water color to make it more distinctive against the snow.
 Update – Modified the center tower to make it easier for climbing.

notes.title: The Great Server Update!
notes.notes:
Update Log 0.5.7

From the Goblin King:
I have rebuilt the server code. Pray I don't rebuild it further...

General

 Updated to the latest version of unity.
 Updated the networking dependencies to the latest version (always stressful).
 I have refactored the tagging code, it should be way better now. In general no more punching without actually tagging (though it may continue to punch after you tag)
 The camera should be hard locked to your goblin now. If at any time you have control of the goblin, and the camera is missing, it will spawn a new camera to lock it back on.


New Content

 New skin – Skeleton Outfit


Bugs

 Fixed a hidden bug that never came up before the server code rebuild because it always won a race condition. Upon upgrading the server, it started to lose the race condition and become apparent. This bug would cause a map to try to wait for players while switching levels instead of being in the inactive state. This caused mass chaos for the server.
 Condensed and refactored a lot of server and game mode code. This should solve a BUNCH of different issues.


Hide and seek
	Island
	
 Fixed the spawn location of runners so they don’t start on top of the taggers.
 	Platforms now have colliders.


Dodgeball
	
 Fixed the score not updating correctly in the GUI.
 	Dodgeball is now 50% bigger.
 	Dodgeball is now 50% faster.

	
Goblin Tag
	
 Fixed a bug where taggers wouldn’t get a random ability if they forgot to click one.

notes.title: The Great Tagger Update
notes.notes:
From the Goblin King:

Hello! First off, I’m super happy to see all of the new campers joining the fun and having at blast at the Goblin Summer Camp. With all of these new players, we have had a lot of good bug finding and gameplay testing. I will try to keep up and add all the new features you want, while beating back the bugs with a heavy stick.

Please be patient with the Goblin King as he has a day job and many other responsibilities :D

General Updates

The camera should no longer unhook from players… probably.
I think I fixed the damn explore button … for the 4th time.
Updated a sound issue where levels would update on goblin spawning.

Goblin Tag Updates

Added Tagger Upgrades so those damn runners wont beat you forever:


 Get 50% bigger
 Create wall for 20 seconds
 Speed up 20%


 Goblin Glade
 Actually turned on these kill boxes.

Goblin Valley
 Updated the kill boxes so they actually kill goblins who run on the edges.
 Fixed the sky. It ran away at some point?

 Goblin Temple
 Fixed two holes in the map that would cause you to fall forever.

 Goblin Canyon 
 Fixed a hole in the map that would cause you to fall forever.

notes.title: The Cosmetics Update
notes.notes:
Today I am releasing the first 4 cosmetic skins in a DLC pack so people can help support the development of the game! The pack will include 10 Skins in total when it is complete. The price of the DLC will be increased by 2 dollars once final 6 skins are added into the game.

Thank you all very much, I hope you like cheese goblins.
